trial_court: Family Court, Ahmedabad, Family Suit (Hindu Marriage Petition) No.1359 of 2007
facts_of_case: The respondent husband instituted a petition for restitution of conjugal rights under Section 13(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 before the Family Court, Ahmedabad. The petitioner wife has to attend every date of adjournment at the Family Court with her minor son, which creates difficulty.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another court for the convenience of the parties.
legal_principles.held: Having heard the learned counsel for the applicant and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the proceedings of Family Suit (Hindu Marriage Petition) No.1359 of 2007 is ordered to be transferred from the Court of learned Family Court, Ahmedabad to the Court of Principal Senior Civil Judge, Mehsana.

legal_principles.principle: A court may consider the difficulties faced by a party in attending proceedings when deciding whether to transfer a case.
legal_principles.held: Thus, She has to attend every date of adjourned at Family Court at Ahmedabad with her minor son, which creates lot of difficulty on the part of present applicant.

outcome.final_order: The proceedings of Family Suit (Hindu Marriage Petition) No.1359 of 2007 are ordered to be transferred from the Court of learned Family Court, Ahmedabad to the Court of learned Principal Senior Civil Judge, Mehsana.

use_for_drafting: advising on transfer of matrimonial disputes
assisting in restitution of conjugal rights cases
